title: subagent: Find APOD Aug 2015 city lights

content:
I need to find information about NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) from the first week of August 2015 (August 1-7, 2015). One of these pictures shows the lights of a city on the horizon. The namesake of this city (the person the city is named after) also has a landmark building in Chicago named after him. I need to find:
1. Which APOD from August 1-7, 2015 shows city lights on the horizon
2. What city is shown (and who it's named after)
3. What landmark building in Chicago is named after that person
4. What architectural firm designed that building
5. The first name appearing in the name of the firm as of June 2023

Please search the web for this information. Start by finding the APOD archive for August 2015 and identify which image shows city lights on the horizon. Then trace the city to its namesake, find the Chicago landmark building, and the architectural firm.
I'll start by searching for the APOD archive for August 2015 to identify the image showing city lights on the horizon.

arguments.query: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day August 1-7 2015 city lights horizon
